written: 2026-09-13, before the adapter existed and before any variant was run on this data
track: E-B, oracle-candidate: evidence turns identified by the benchmark's has_answer flags; slot and value hand-normalised per turn before the run and frozen; the same normalised writes are given to every variant

variants.v0_scd_g: v0_scd plus a global confidence guard (inert here: hand-normalised writes carry no confidence structure, so it must behave exactly as v0_scd)
variants.v4_replace: TypedMem with every slot declared conflict=replace (default guard)
variants.v4_keep_both: TypedMem with every slot declared conflict=keep_both
variants.v4_default: TypedMem with its shipped DEFAULT_POLICIES by state type: fact/count/routine/duration/boolean → fact (keep_both); preference → preference (replace); goal → goal (replace)

structural_fact_that_drives_the_predicti: In this benchmark observed order == valid order for every usable question (each later statement supersedes the earlier one and no statement carries a validity date), and every write is the user's own statement with no confidence structure. So on current-state questions all six variants reduce to 'latest write wins' and should tie; the only mechanism that can separate them is whether history is retained.

current_state (53).note: no separation predicted; any difference is adapter or normalisation, and is attributed as such

historical_state (6).v4_replace: ≈0% — the earlier value is overwritten in place; expected answer None
historical_state (6).v4_default: ≈100% for fact-typed slots (keep_both); 0% for any preference/goal-typed slot (replace)

accumulation (1).all: ≈100%, because the normaliser resolves the delta into an absolute value; reported separately as a normalisation artefact, not a mechanism result

abstention (6).all: 100% — no write exists for the slot; every variant must return None

pre_registered_reading.if_current_state_ties: Finding 1 SURVIVED on external current-state data: a bitemporal table is sufficient; TypedMem adds nothing and loses nothing here.
pre_registered_reading.if_v4_replace_loses_history: the Mode A known gap (history_under_replace) reproduced on data not designed around TypedMem; recorded as an external failure of the replace contract, not as a failure of Finding 1.
pre_registered_reading.if_v4_keep_both_or_default_ties_scd_on_h: TypedMem CAN express history — the limitation is that replace and keep_both are exclusive: a slot cannot both have one governing value and a queryable past. That is the contract statement to carry into Mode B / the paper.
pre_registered_reading.if_anything_else: investigate the disagreement; attribute to normalisation before attributing to a mechanism; change nothing during the run.
